Dear Halcyon Payroll Services, Inc. team,

We are writing to dispute the charges on invoice {invoices} under {agreement}.

The agreement states: "{escalator_clause}" The increase may therefore take effect only on the anniversary of the Effective Date, which is {first_application}. It does not apply earlier.

On {applied_from}, Halcyon applied the {escalator_pct} increase early. The contract monthly fee is {contract_monthly}, but the amount billed was {charged_monthly}. The difference is {overcharge_monthly} per month, and the total overcharge to date is {overcharged_to_date}.

Please issue a credit for {overcharged_to_date} and confirm that it will be applied to our account. Going forward, please bill the Monthly Service Fee at {contract_monthly} until {first_application}, and send a corrected invoice reflecting this.

Please confirm receipt of this dispute and let us know when we can expect the credit and corrected bill.

Thank you,

{sender}
